publicDeclarationReviews.fullFrozenHead:
theorem weightedGaussian_summable (c x : ℝ) (r : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) (hx : 0 < x) :
    Summable (weightedGaussian c r x) := by
publicDeclarationReviews.proofReview: Set C=c*x>0 and N=n+1>=1. N<=N^2, hence N^r<=(N^2)^r. The qualified monomial profile at q=C*N^2>=0 absorbs (N^2)^r into exp(-C*N^2/2) with K=(1/C)^r*2^r*r!. Qualified Gaussian summability at C/2 survives the injective shift n->n+1. Explicit cast/eta transport and norm comparison establish Summable of the literal weighted function for every c>0,x>0.

publicDeclarationReviews.name: Shao.C2.IntervalSpectralGaussian.weightedGaussian_split_bound
publicDeclarationReviews.fullFrozenHead:
theorem weightedGaussian_split_bound (c x : ℝ) (r n : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    weightedGaussian c r x n ≤ Real.exp (-(c / 2) * x) * weightedGaussian (c / 2) r 1 n := by
publicDeclarationReviews.proofReview: For x>=1 and N=n+1>=1, N^2<=N^2*x and x<=N^2*x give N^2+x<=2*N^2*x. Multiplication by c>0 proves the displayed exponent inequality. Exponential monotonicity and nonnegative N^r give the exact split into exp(-(c/2)*x) and weightedGaussian(c/2,r,1,n).

publicDeclarationReviews.name: Shao.C2.IntervalSpectralGaussian.weightedGaussian_tsum_split
publicDeclarationReviews.fullFrozenHead:
theorem weightedGaussian_tsum_split (c x : ℝ) (r : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    (∑' n : ℕ, weightedGaussian c r x n) ≤
      Real.exp (-(c / 2) * x) * (∑' n : ℕ, weightedGaussian (c / 2) r 1 n) := by
publicDeclarationReviews.proofReview: Both original and comparison weighted series are summable by the preceding theorem, at x>0 and at 1. Pointwise nonnegativity identifies the norms. HasSum.mul_left and HasSum.norm_le_of_bounded then sum the exact pointwise split. This is an infinite-series argument with all convergence hypotheses supplied.

publicDeclarationReviews.name: Shao.C2.IntervalSpectralGaussian.sqrt_power_exp_bound
publicDeclarationReviews.fullFrozenHead:
theorem sqrt_power_exp_bound (c x : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    (Real.sqrt x) ^ p * Real.exp (-c * x) ≤
      (1 / c) ^ p * (2 : ℝ) ^ p * (Nat.factorial p : ℝ) := by
publicDeclarationReviews.proofReview: x>=1 gives x>=0 and sqrt(x)<=x. Raise to any natural p, multiply by the positive exponential, and apply the qualified monomial profile at q=c*x>=0. Exact cancellation of c^p uses c!=0. The remaining exp(-c*x/2)<=1 yields precisely (1/c)^p*2^p*p!, including p=0.

    0 ≤ spectralConstant c r := by
publicDeclarationReviews.proofReview: Every scalar factor is nonnegative when c>0 and the remaining tsum is nonnegative termwise. This remaining Gaussian moment series is also summable by weightedGaussian_summable at c/2,1; the definition is not used to hide divergent finiteness.

publicDeclarationReviews.name: Shao.C2.IntervalSpectralGaussian.weightedGaussian_scaled_bound
publicDeclarationReviews.fullFrozenHead:
theorem weightedGaussian_scaled_bound (c x : ℝ) (r : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) (hx : 1 ≤ x) :

    (hT : 0 < T) (hHigh : a ^ 2 ≤ T) :
    |z - y| / Real.sqrt T ≤ 2 ∧ 1 + |z - y| / Real.sqrt T ≤ 3 := by
publicDeclarationReviews.proofReview: a>0,a^2<=T,T>0 and (sqrt T)^2=T give a<=sqrt T. Closed endpoint guards imply |z-y|<=2a. Divide only by the positive sqrt T to obtain |z-y|/sqrt T<=2 and D<=3. Unused explicit ha lint is harmless.

      (0 ≤ (a + y) * (a + z) ∧ (a + y) * (a + z) ≤ 4 * T) := by
publicDeclarationReviews.proofReview: All four wall distances are in [0,2a] by the closed endpoint hypotheses. Multiplication preserves order, so each wall product lies in [0,4a^2], hence [0,4T]. This theorem does not divide by T and does not require an additional time premise.

  ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ r * Real.exp (-c * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * x)

def spectralConstant (c : ℝ) (r : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / (c / 2)) ^ (r + 1) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (r + 1) * (Nat.factorial (r + 1) : ℝ) *
    (∑' n : ℕ, weightedGaussian (c / 2) r 1 n)

    0 ≤ weightedGaussian c r x n := by

    weightedGaussian c r x n ≤ Real.exp (-(c / 2) * x) * weightedGaussian (c / 2) r 1 n := by

theorem weightedGaussian_tsum_split (c x : ℝ) (r : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    (∑' n : ℕ, weightedGaussian c r x n) ≤
      Real.exp (-(c / 2) * x) * (∑' n : ℕ, weightedGaussian (c / 2) r 1 n) := by

theorem sqrt_power_exp_bound (c x : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    (Real.sqrt x) ^ p * Real.exp (-c * x) ≤
      (1 / c) ^ p * (2 : ℝ) ^ p * (Nat.factorial p : ℝ) := by

theorem spectralConstant_nonneg (c : ℝ) (r : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) :
